Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid scandal and China-related concerns

• Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO amid affair allegations and doubts about China-related GPU sales.
• OpenAI’s new ChatGPT Wallet lets approved U.S. users have Dots agents purchase items after biometric confirmation.
• A network-capacity upgrade caused a 24-hour global outage of Microsoft 365, affecting millions of users and essential services.

items.text:
Microsoft’s network upgrade knocked out Outlook for tens of millions worldwide.

• Outlook, Teams and other Microsoft 365 services failed across 70+ countries.
• The outage lasted about 24 hours, disrupting governments, airlines and hospitals.
• Businesses now face a single-point-of-failure risk in their core workflows.

Do this: Relying on one cloud provider can stall your entire operation—plan backups now.

Your take: How will you safeguard critical work tools? Tell us in the comments.
